title: On the Pixel 8: built-in Hard against Stockfish at UCI_Elo 2200
description: The same match as the Mac calibration, but played on the phone: the app's real built-in Hard engine (0.3 s per move, a fresh search table every move, exactly as the app plays it) against Stockfish limited to 2200 Elo, also 0.3 s per move, both running on the Pixel 8. The phone's CPU is much slower than the Mac for the built-in engine, so this measures what a player actually faces.
hypothesis: Finds where the built-in engine stops winning on the phone itself; no direction assumed.
